name: Peak-time techno
key_tendency: Minor keys (A minor, F minor are common); a short riff or stab carries the hook.
signature: Driving 909 kick, offbeat open hat, clap on 2 and 4
Rolling 16th bass that sits between the kicks
Short minor stabs or a hypnotic riff
Noise risers and big filter builds into the drop
16-bar sections with clear tension and release
listen_for: The bass fills the gaps between the kicks, so the low end never stops moving. The drop lands harder because the build strips the kick away first.

parts.chords:
const chords = chord("<Am Am F G>").voicing().struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(1800).decay(0.25).sustain(0).room(0.5).gain(0.3)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [8, stack(drums, bass.mask("<0 1>/4"))],
  [8, stack(drums.mask("1 1 1 0"), bass, chords, fx)],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(chords.room(0.8), lead.lpf(900), fx)],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords, lead)],
)
